newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: OZ Zurich to apply for banking license.
newsitem.headline: OZ Zurich to apply for banking license.

text.p: OZ Zurich AG, the operational unit of OZ Holding, has applied to the Swiss Banking Commission for a banking license, OZ Holding said in a statement.
OZ Zurich is an options and futures broker and part of the BZ Group holding, chaired by financier Martin Ebner.
BZ Group, which owns 53 percent of OZ's capital, intends to reduce its stake, a OZ statement said, quoting Ebner at the annual meeting of OZ Holding.
OZ's commission income has already reached around five million Swiss francs in the first two months of the current year, around one-third of last year's result.
Net profit in the first two months was almost 22 million francs, the statement added, quoting Andreas Walther, member of OZ's board.
